शो India's Got Latent के मंच पर समय रैना का नया कारनामा सामने आया है! 🎬

समय रैना ने शो में आई एक्ट्रेस हुमा कुरैशी के सामने उनकी फिल्म Toxic के फ्लॉप बॉक्स ऑफिस पर तगड़ा तंज कसा। समय ने चुटकी लेते हुए कहा कि आमतौर पर लोग इस शो में आने के बाद फिल्म फ्लॉप कराते हैं, लेकिन हुमा पहली मेहमान हैं जो फिल्म फ्लॉप कराके यहां आई हैं! 😲

इस पर हुमा कुरैशी ने भी करारा जवाब दिया और कहा कि उन्होंने सिर्फ Toxic नाम की फिल्म में काम किया है, जबकि समय असल जिंदगी में टॉक्सिक हैं।

बता दें कि गीतू मोहनदास के डायरेक्शन में बनी और 26 August को रिलीज़ हुई यश की फिल्म Toxic का बजट बहुत बड़ा था, लेकिन यह ₹350 crore का आंकड़ा भी पार नहीं कर सकी। A-rating वाली इस फिल्म को इसके वायलेंस और बोल्ड सीन्स के लिए काफी आलोचना झेलनी पड़ी थी। 🔥

क्या आपने समय रैना का यह एपिसोड देखा? आपको हुमा कुरैशी का यह जवाब कैसा लगा, कमेंट्स में ज़रूर बताइए! 👇

ctx.title: Samay Raina takes a dig at the box office performance of Toxic in front of Huma Qureshi on India's Got Latent
ctx.summary: Yash's pan-India film Toxic opened to divisive reviews and underperformed at the box office.
ctx.text:
Toxic: A Fairytale for Grown-Ups was supposed to be Yash’s grand comeback to the big screen. The Geetu Mohandas film saw the ‘Rocking Star’ of Kannada cinema return to the silver screen for the first time in four years, following the KGF films. Made on a massive budget with a huge star cast and a grand scale, the film had everything going for it. But the film underperformed at the box office and wind up under ₹ 350 crore.
Huma Qureshi played Elizabeth in Toxic. The actor was one of the celebrity guests who appeared on Samay Raina 's India's Got Latent. During the episode, Samay did not miss the opportunity to mention Toxic and took a dig at its box office performance. He said, "Usually people come on India's Got Latent, and then their movie flops. You're the first one to flop a movie and then show up here."
Huma quipped, "Dude, I just acted in a movie named Toxic, you're literally toxic in life." Samay playfully added, "But at least people watch me." Huma then said that nowadays there's also hate-watching that gets a high metric these days so no wonder India's Got Latent is on top. Samay giggled and said the same will apply for Toxic, and recalled watching a lot of sex scenes in the trailer itself. Huma laughed and said that when Samay calls the guests to come on the show he is very well spoken but during the show he is always spitting out poison!
Toxic, directed by Geetu Mohandas, also stars Nayanthara , Kiara Advani, Rukmini Vasanth, and Tara Sutaria in the lead roles. The film was released in theatres on August 26. Toxic has been in the news for its steamy, intimate scenes and sequences that appear to show women in a not-so-favourable light through imagery and dialogue. The film was cleared by the CBFC with no cuts and an A-rating.
The film was criticised for its violence, sensual scenes and lack of emotional depth after its release. Hindustan Times’ review of Toxic reads, “Yash and Geetu will want you to believe that Toxic is the antithesis of glorifying violent and problematic characters. They want you to believe that this film is about a man who becomes his own undoing. An anti-hero, or an outright villain, who faces the consequences of his actions. But this moment comes after over 3 heroes of babying, coddling and pandering to the whims of a man.”
